description:

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0446940-DC/Si-D/GB-[ MP / P1 170000136]Charger is intermittently losing connection CRM:02681000719
additional_info.body:
Dear Adam,
I am reaching out from the
Technical Support Team
in regards of ticket
ID0446940.
Apologies for the delayed answer.
I had an overview to the OCPP connection of the charger over the past week, and indeed the charger loses the connection to the OCPP backend several times per day. I connected remotely to the charger, and I see that:
Router XF3 (Siemens Backend) has an excellent signal
Router XF4 (OCPP Backend) has a weaker signal:
From my side, I can force router XF4 to connect only with 4G signal, which could help the signal stability. I tested it and the signal got slightly stronger:
May I ask you if you tried already to change operator? This could help in case signal from the selected operator is weak in that location. Other solutions such as replace the router or have router 2 connecting to the wifi of router 1 could be explored.
Looking forward to hearing your feedback soon.
With kind regards,
Fosco Servidei
